frequency_question: What proportion of congressional review resolutions for executive agreements complete all required chamber passages and avoid or override a veto within the statutory window?
membership_rule: Includes any joint resolution introduced pursuant to statutory disapproval mechanisms for major international agreements; excludes standard non-binding resolutions or ordinary bills.

cases.name: Iran Nuclear Agreement Review Act resolution attempts (JCPOA)

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named instances covering all major comparable modern nuclear and strategic arms sales review attempts under statutory clocks.

skeleton: Legislative review periods initiated across recent major Middle East arms and nuclear frameworks, multiplied by the completion rate of veto overrides.
multiplier: 3 past legislative disapproval attempts on similar bilateral Middle East security/nuclear pacts, divided by successful completions (0 overrides of presidential vetoes on these specific foreign policy disapproval resolutions).
validity_reason: Statutory review timelines under the Atomic Energy Act remain stable until legislative reform alters the statutory review period.
